title: Project Manager
description:
**Job Title**


Project Manager**Job Description Summary**


The MEP Manager is responsible for leading and managing all Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) services for construction projects from design to commissioning. The role involves planning, coordination, and execution of MEP systems to ensure they meet design intent, quality standards, timelines, safety norms, and budget targets. The position requires close collaboration with architects, structural engineers, consultants, contractors, and clients to deliver integrated and efficient building systems.**Job Description**

**About the Role:**

* Oversee complete MEP planning, design review, and implementation for all construction projects.
* Coordinate with design consultants and architects to ensure design compliance with project requirements and applicable codes.
* Integrate MEP systems with structural and architectural works.
* Manage day\-to\-day site activities related to HVAC, electrical, plumbing, firefighting, BMS, and other MEP installations.
* Ensure that all work is executed as per approved drawings, specifications, and safety standards.
* Supervise and monitor MEP subcontractors and vendors for timely delivery and installation.
* Conduct regular inspections and ensure adherence to quality standards and statutory regulations.
* Review material submittals, method statements, and technical drawings.
* Ensure compliance with local building codes, IS standards, and client specifications.
* Prepare and monitor MEP budgets and cost estimates.
* Review and approve vendor quotations and subcontractor bills.
* Identify and control cost overruns through value engineering and efficient resource utilization.
* Plan, supervise, and validate the testing and commissioning of all MEP systems.
* Ensure proper handover documentation and O\&M manuals are submitted to the client.
* Lead a team of MEP engineers and site supervisors across multiple projects.
* Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and training to the team.
* Act as the main point of contact for all MEP\-related discussions with the client and consultants.
* Present progress reports and resolve any design or execution conflicts proactively.

**About You:**

* MEP Design \& Coordination
* Project Execution \& Commissioning
* Cost \& Budget Management
* Vendor/Subcontractor Management
* Quality Assurance \& Safety Compliance
* Value Engineering
* Leadership \& Team Development
* Client \& Consultant Communication
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical / electrical engineering (Master’s preferred).
* Experience: 10\+ years of experience in MEP design, execution, and project management within the construction industry.
* Proven track record in managing large\-scale commercial, industrial, or residential projects.
* Strong understanding of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, firefighting, and ELV systems.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit MEP, and MS Project/Primavera.

**Why join Cushman \& Wakefield?**

As one of the leading global real estate services firms transforming the way people work, shop and live working at Cushman \& Wakefield means you will benefit from;

* Being part of a growing global company;
* Career development and a promote from within culture;
* An organisation committed to Diversity and Inclusion


We're committed to providing work\-life balance for our people in an inclusive, rewarding environment.  

We achieve this by providing a flexible and agile work environment by focusing on technology and autonomy to help our people achieve their career ambitions. We focus on career progression and foster a promotion from within culture, leveraging global opportunities to ensure we retain our top talent. We encourage continuous learning and development opportunities to develop personal, professional and technical capabilities, and we reward with a comprehensive employee benefits program.

**We have a vision of the future, where people simply belong.**

*That's why we support and celebrate inclusive causes, not just on days of recognition throughout the year, but every day. We embrace diversity across race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or persons with disabilities or protected veteran status.*

*We ensure DEI is part of our DNA as a global community \- it means we go way beyond than just talking about it \- we live it. If you want to live it too, join us.*

title: Project Engineer
description:
**Job Title**


Project Engineer**Job Description Summary**


The Proejct Engineer (Civil) supports the Project Manager in planning, coordinating, and executing all phases of construction projects. This role ensures that projects are delivered safely on time, within scope, budget, and quality standards. The position involves hands\-on site supervision, contractor coordination, documentation management, and stakeholder communication.**Job Description**

**About the Role:**

* Assist the Project Manager in developing project schedules, budgets, and execution plans.
* Coordinate with design consultants, contractors, and vendors to ensure alignment with project timelines.
* Monitor daily progress at site and report deviations from schedule or quality requirements.
* Support in planning and allocation of resources, manpower, and materials.
* Supervise civil and structural works at site to ensure compliance with drawings and specifications.
* Conduct regular inspections and ensure work quality as per approved standards and safety norms.
* Coordinate with MEP, interior, and finishing teams for seamless project execution.
* Identify site challenges and propose practical solutions in consultation with the Project Manager.
* Prepare and maintain daily progress reports, snag lists, and inspection records.
* Review and track contractor submittals, RFIs, and material approvals.
* Assist in preparation of Minutes of Meetings (MOMs) and project status reports.
* Maintain updated documentation for quality assurance and project audits.
* Assist in quantity take\-offs, BOQ verification, and cost tracking.
* Review contractor bills, certification of measurements, and payment recommendations.
* Coordinate with procurement for timely delivery of materials and equipment.
* Ensure adherence to quality control procedures and construction safety standards.
* Support in implementation of project HSE (Health, Safety, Environment) plans.
* Follow up for closure of NCRs (Non\-Conformance Reports) and quality observations.
* Support the Project Manager in client meetings and coordination with consultants.
* Ensure timely communication and update on project progress to all stakeholders.
* Assist in project handover and close\-out documentation.

**About You:**

* Strong technical knowledge in civil and structural works.
* Excellent project coordination and documentation skills.
* Ability to interpret drawings and specifications.
* Proficiency in MS Project / Primavera for scheduling (preferred).
* Strong communication, analytical, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Working knowledge of AutoCAD, MS Office, and other construction tools.
* Exposure to large\-scale commercial, IT park, or corporate interior projects.
* Knowledge of LEED / green building practices (added advantage).
* Familiarity with contract administration and vendor management.
* Documentation \& Reporting Proficiency: Skilled in preparing technical reports, progress documentation, material submittal reviews, and MEP\-related billing verification.
* Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering (master’s degree in project management or construction management preferred).
* 5–10 years of experience in civil construction or project management, preferably in commercial, industrial, or real estate projects.
* Good understanding of civil engineering drawings, structural works, finishing activities, and project sequencing.
* Experience in handling contractors, consultants, and clients on\-site.

title: Project Erection & Site Management
description:
**Job Requirements**  

Site Engineer must ensure safe, correct, and timely **installation of DG sets, panels, fuel system, exhaust system, earthing, and cabling** as per approved drawings, standards, and safety norms. **Data Centre experience is preferred**.

  

* Pre\-Site Preparation \& Resource Readiness – Verify approved drawings, layouts, P\&IDs, piping/cable schedules, and ensure site readiness, manpower safety induction, tools, lifting equipment, testing kits, and PPE availability before mobilization.
* Material Handling \& Equipment Installation – Inspect and verify receipt/storage of DG sets, heat exchangers, pumps, cooling towers, piping, valves, and accessories; carry out proper installation, alignment, levelling, grouting, and mounting of DG sets and associated equipment as per approved drawings.
* Mechanical System Installation – Execute installation of exhaust, fuel, water cooling, and piping systems including silencers, insulation, flexible joints, valves, strainers, NRVs, vents, drains, supports, expansion loops, and hydro/pressure testing of pipelines.
* Cooling Water \& Cooling Tower Integration – Install and commission heat exchangers, cooling water/raw water pumps, cooling tower structures, piping connections, gauges, VFD/starter panels, and ensure proper alignment, rotation checks, water quality, and chemical dosing systems.
* Electrical, Cabling \& Earthing Works – Install AMF/synchronizing panels, lay and terminate LT/HT cables, verify control wiring/interlocks for DG–HE–Pump–CT systems, conduct IR tests, and ensure proper earthing/bonding with resistance monitoring and logs.
* Pre\-Commissioning \& Testing Activities – Perform leak tests, hydrotests, insulation tests, alignment and rotation checks, verify oil/coolant/fuel/battery conditions, confirm relay settings, alarms, interlocks, and sensor feedback systems before commissioning.
* Safety, Compliance \& Project Documentation – Ensure adherence to PPE, PTW, rigging, welding, fire safety, MSDS, and site safety practices while maintaining daily logs, installation/test reports, inspection clearances, as\-built drawings, and final handover**.**

  

**Work Experience**  

Site Execution, Erection Management, Testing \& Commissioning, Contractor Management, Project Planning

title: Asst Project Manager_DC
description:
**What will you do:**



As a Senior Service Engineer, you will deliver advanced service, commissioning, and troubleshooting expertise for chiller systems in mission\-critical data center environments. You will:


* Perform service, preventive maintenance, and corrective repairs on Air\-Cooled and Water\-Cooled Chillers, including screw, scroll, and centrifugal systems.
* Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and control\-related issues in chiller and HVAC systems.
* Conduct chiller start\-up, commissioning, performance testing, and system optimization.
* Manage site execution for data center cooling projects, including planning, installation oversight, and coordination with contractors and OEM teams.
* Support upgrades, retrofits, and energy\-efficiency improvements in existing cooling infrastructure.
* Review technical drawings, wiring diagrams, P\&IDs, submittals, and project documents for accuracy and compliance.
* Maintain detailed service reports, performance logs, and equipment documentation.
* Ensure compliance with safety standards, regulatory requirements, and customer\-specific operational protocols.
* Provide technical mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.
* Interface regularly with customers to provide updates, clarify technical issues, and ensure timely project and service completion.
* Conduct root\-cause analysis and implement corrective/preventive actions.
* Collaborate with internal teams including sales, engineering, and project management to ensure seamless service delivery.
* Submit RCA and 8D reports in a timely manner.
* Attend Monthly MOR and Quarterly QBR meetings with data center clients.


**What you will bring: (Skills \& Competencies)**


* Strong expertise in Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chillers, ideally in data center environments.
* Deep understanding of refrigeration cycles, HVAC controls, BMS/EMS integration, and redundancy concepts.
* Proficiency in diagnosing mechanical, electrical, and controls issues using diagnostic tools and software.
* Ability to interpret wiring diagrams, technical drawings, P\&IDs, and OEM manuals.
* Strong communication skills to operate effectively in mission‑critical customer environments.
* Sound knowledge of safety standards and best practices.
* Strong problem\-solving capability and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Experience supporting mission\-critical data centers or large industrial cooling systems.
* OEM\-specific training or certifications (Trane, Carrier, Daikin) preferred.
* Knowledge of energy\-efficiency programs, retrofits, and performance optimization.
* Project management experience or certification is a plus.


We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

Job Title: Project Manager – Construction

**Company:** Kapil Power \& Infra (P) Ltd.  
**Experience:** 10\+ Years  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Salary:** Negotiable based on experience and interview performance  
**Location:** Project/Site Locations

Job Summary

Kapil Power \& Infra (P) Ltd. is seeking an experienced **Project Manager – Construction** to oversee construction projects, site execution, project coordination, quality, timelines, resources and team management.

The ideal candidate should have **10\+ years of relevant construction/project management experience** and be capable of independently managing project/site operations.

Responsibilities

* Manage end\-to\-end construction activities at assigned project sites.
* Plan and monitor project execution and ensure timely completion.
* Supervise site engineers, supervisors, contractors and subcontractors.
* Coordinate with clients, consultants, vendors and internal departments.
* Monitor manpower, materials, equipment and other project resources.
* Ensure construction work follows approved drawings, specifications and quality standards.
* Conduct site inspections and quality checks.
* Track project progress and identify potential delays or execution issues.
* Resolve site\-level technical and operational challenges.
* Prepare and maintain project reports, records and documentation.
* Ensure compliance with safety requirements and company policies.
* Provide regular project updates to management.
* Ensure proper site management, supervision and team coordination.

Requirements

* Minimum **10\+ years of experience** in construction/project management.
* Strong experience in site execution and construction management.
* Good knowledge of construction processes and project coordination.

Compensation

**Salary will be discussed and finalized based on the candidate's experience, skills and interview performance.**
